comment: LT Part 4 stages 4 and 5: an evolutionary search over the top 15 screening levers plus alwaysLevers, seeded with the best pairs. Each candidate plays searchCells; the best finalCount then play finalCells (every fight, 20 seeds, three parties), and the 5 best that differ by at least minDistance levers become tuned_1..5 in data/lab/presets.json. finalMinutes is kept back for that check.
